meta.parties: In the Matter of An Appeal Under Section 32 of the Stamp Ordinance, No. 22 of 1909

rules.statement: A donor is entitled to reserve a life-interest in favor of a third party, and such reservation should be stamped under item 30 (a) rather than item 30 (c).
rules.supporting_quote: "A donor is entitled in the same instrument without any other stamp duty than is necessary for a conveyance to distribute the various rights which make up the ownership to various persons as she pleases. Item 30 (c) steps in only when she reserves anything to herself."
